title: Pacific Slate
excerpt: A self-hosted AI system that remembers, works in the background, and runs on hardware I own. What it does, and the design decisions behind it.
content_html:
I was in the first year of an MBA, trying to manage a firehose of information while applying to internships and keeping up with my wife and two kids, and I kept re-explaining my whole situation to whatever AI program I was using that week. I wanted one that updated itself, filtered the slop, and kept the data mine.

I built this website to share the structure for anyone looking to do something similar. This isn’t meant to be a service or product to purchase, it’s something you can hand off to your own LLM and use as a guide.

It runs on a rented server, a dedicated machine that hosts the services and holds encrypted backups of the files I care about. I designed it, selected the parts, and run it day to day (technical details in the collapsed sections at the bottom).

What it does

  • Updates itself from my sources, sorts through the noise, and maintains the data in my privately owned database.
  • Uses a multi-agent tree to route work to the model best suited for it.
  • Remembers my choices and preferences, and learns from past outcomes (applying lessons learned to new tasks or situations).
  • Cites sources and maintains logs of everything it does, allowing for traceability and accountability.
  • Checks the source document rather than trusting what it remembers.
  • Integrates into the tools and services I already use, so it adjusts to my workflow rather than forcing me to change it.

What I stopped building

I learned quickly to prioritize durability, utility, and productivity over novelty. The system is not a product, and it is not a research project. It is a tool I use every day, and it has to work when I’m not there or don’t have the time to maintain it. I had originally built mobile and desktop clients to reach it, but they were more work than I could comfortably invest. I deleted them and now reach it from the tools (MCP, plugins, hooks) commonplace throughout AI development. It’s been important to futureproof the system, and the design is intentionally service-agnostic so it can flex to whatever is best at the time.

How a request is handled

Eight agents do the work: one that reads the request and routes it, and seven specialists for research, code, analysis, review, and related work. Each runs on a model chosen for that job, so a short lookup and a long analysis do not draw the same cost or wait on the same machinery.

Answers carry their sources, so a claim can be traced, and the cost of the call, so spending stays visible as it happens rather than at the end of the month.

The interface

The workspace, from the public demo. Answers arrive as cards that can be moved around rather than as one long thread, each labeled with the model used, the cost, and the time taken.

Demo: pacslate.com/demo. The real interface on sample data.

  • Canvas. Enter a prompt or watch it run. Open
  • Monitor. A dashboard. Seismic data and headlines are live, fetched in the browser; markets, aircraft, and anything personal are labeled sample data. Open

What is mine and what is rented

The parts that accumulate stay on my server. The model is rented.

The model is the one part I do not control, so it is treated as replaceable. Substituting a better one is a configuration change.

What is stored is exportable and deletable, and is not used for training. Requests that go out are restricted to zero-data-retention endpoints, at providers configured not to train on them or publish them (account settings, August 2026). Where nothing should leave the server, work can be pointed at a model running on it.

I hold what accumulates, I decide where requests go, and none of it becomes a vendor’s asset.

Open source, and what I pay for

Almost all of it is open source, assembled and run on my own server rather than rented as a service. Where an open-source equivalent did the job, I switched to it and kept the data. What I still pay for is the model, and one hosted memory service that stays swappable and is not the system of record.

Building it

While computer science and software engineering have always been intriguing, I didn’t have any background developing code myself. The development of this system has been possible through working in partnership with the numerous tools and services currently available online. The architecture itself has all been created independently: which components exist, how they connect, what each runs on, how it behaves when a part fails, and what it is allowed to ‘spend’ (the budget for each module or platform). I built it AI-natively, specifying and reviewing while coding agents wrote most of the code.

It has run since early 2026 and I use it daily. Most of what the technical sections describe came out of operating it rather than planning it. For example, the fallback layer exists because the framework’s own fallback setting turned out to do nothing. Another instance, the model label on every answer exists as a way to backtrace a behavioral regression to a model swap that was invisible in the logs. Most of the issues I hit in production were not bugs but design gaps, and it was only through operating the system that I discovered them.

Because I built Pacific Slate while working and going to grad school, my free time (or lack thereof) shaped the design more than anything else. It had to be useful in the hours I wasn’t there: scheduled runs, low-risk dependencies and security updates that merge on their own, and failures that degrade to a working state rather than waiting for me.

Technical detail

Model names on this page and in the example config are illustrative; the design is model-agnostic and the roster rotates. Counts are current as of August 2026 and were checked against the running system.

1 · Agents and memory · the design, not the assembly

A designed multi-agent system, not a chat model with plugins.

A multi-agent tree on Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK): one operator at the root plus seven specialists (coder, researcher, analyst, productivity, reviewer, evaluator, and a research sub-agent scoped to the coder).

  • Cost and fit. Each role maps to the model best suited and priced for its work.
  • Independent review. The evaluator runs on a different model family than the agents whose output it scores. Different weights are not guaranteed different biases, but it beats self-scoring. The reviewer is a separate instance kept off the write path by policy.
  • Least privilege. Tools are scoped per role by explicit allow-list. The researcher cannot reach infrastructure. The reviewer is read-only by charter. The productivity agent’s credentials are isolated, so a failure there cannot take down the operator.
  • Containment. A rate-limit or crash stays inside one specialist.
  • ADK enforces a single-parent constraint on sub-agents, which is why the coder’s research arm is a separate instance from the standalone researcher despite sharing a model and tools.
  • Specialists publish findings to a Redis event stream that peers read as ambient context. Longer asynchronous jobs hand off to a background orchestrator rather than occupying the synchronous path.

Model independence. The substrate is exposed two ways: an MCP gateway (tools and memory over the Model Context Protocol, mountable by any MCP-capable client) and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Memory, data, tools, routing, and verification do not move when the model does.

Memory, in four layers.

Layer Function
Knowledge corpus ~14,000 documents, ~196,000 passages. Hybrid retrieval: keyword plus vector similarity
Continuity graph Links related conversations, decisions, and topics over time
Semantic memory Durable facts for cross-session recall, with a nightly reconciliation and de-duplication job
Tiered context Always-loaded core kept small; the rest retrieved on demand

Two rules govern all of it. A deterministic relevance pass decides what to load before any model runs, with no model call. And recalled memory is treated as a lead rather than a fact: if memory says a vendor renews in July, the agent pulls the source document and acts on that.

Proactive jobs. Scheduled routines pull from many sources and score each candidate item for relevance, materiality, and novelty before it can enter a brief. Discarded items are logged rather than dropped silently, so the filter can be audited. A consolidation stage de-duplicates and normalizes before anything is stored, and screens for credentials and personal data on the way in.

Operating principles.

  • Algorithm first. Default data access and classification to something deterministic: regex, an index, SQL, set membership. Use a model only for the irreducible part. The complexity scorer, the tool search, and the memory relevance pass are all applications of this.
  • Make failure visible, then cheap. Each reliability fix pairs a guardrail with a trace, so the same class of problem cannot recur unseen.
  • Resilience over peak capability. Where the two conflict, uptime wins.
  • Cost as a design constraint. A real ceiling forces honest choices about model, context size, and when to use a model at all.

See: examples/model-routing.example.yaml for the routing structure · the model and cost label on each card in the demo.

2 · Integration · models, tools, data, and interface as one system

Model providers, tools, data, memory, and a frontend are integrated into one environment reachable over standard interfaces.

Request path:

  1. The canvas, a Next.js single-page app, opens a streaming connection and posts the prompt. Streaming uses the AG-UI protocol over Server-Sent Events, so tokens, tool calls, and model-resolution events arrive on one stream.
  2. The backend is a Starlette service exposing the AG-UI endpoint for the canvas and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint for other clients.
  3. The operator classifies the request and either answers inline or hands off to a specialist.
  4. The specialist loads context and calls tools over MCP.
  5. The resilient model layer resolves the model for that call, applies cost-aware downgrades and health-aware fallback (section 3), streams the completion, and meters cost.
  6. The answer streams back as a card labeled with model and cost. Durable facts are written to memory.

Two speed tiers result: inline answers in a single model call, and delegated runs where a specialist works its own tool loop.

System diagram. Click to enlarge.

Tool layer. About two dozen tool-servers (memory, retrieval, code execution, git, feeds, infrastructure) behind one token-authenticated gateway, FastMCP over streamable HTTP, each server its own process.

  • Register, do not rewire. New capability means registering a server. The cost is an extra hop and a single failure domain at the gateway, which is why the gateway has its own health check and the fleet is health-polled.
  • Search, do not load. Carrying every tool schema in every agent’s context is expensive and dilutes attention, so the gateway exposes a BM25 search over the tool catalog. The MCP specification only lists tools; this search is an addition.
Layer Choice
Agent framework Google ADK, multi-agent tree
Backend Starlette, AG-UI over SSE plus OpenAI-compatible endpoint
Frontend Next.js, streaming result cards on a spatial canvas
Inter-agent bus Redis event streams
Tooling ~24 MCP servers behind one gateway, BM25 tool search
Operator long-context model with native tool calling
Coder code-specialized model, large context
Researcher fast long-context model, single pass
Analyst large mixture-of-experts reasoning model
Reviewer, evaluator independent of the code-writers, scored on a different model family
Memory hybrid-retrieval corpus, continuity graph, semantic memory, tiered context
Infrastructure Docker, four segmented network tiers, Cloudflare Tunnel, sandboxed execution
Reliability per-role fallback chains, health tracker, first-token watchdog, graceful degrade
Cost per-request metering to a monthly ceiling, full call and swap tracing

See: the diagram above · the demo, which is the same canvas and protocol running against scripted events.

3 · Reliability and cost · the part that took the most iteration

It stays up, stays within budget, and checks its own output, and each of those mechanisms is observable.

Ninety days of traces as of August 2026: 13,053 runs, 26,515 model calls, nine models serving traffic. The median model call completes in 3.1 seconds; the 90th percentile is 14 seconds.

Cost control, applied before the call. A deterministic scorer rates prompt complexity 1 to 5 from word count, keyword classes, code markers, role weight, and conversation depth, with no model involved. That score and current budget state select the tier:

Monthly budget used Behavior
Under 80% Every role on its assigned model
80 to 95% Trivial tasks downgraded
95 to 100% All but essential high-complexity work downgraded
At 100% Non-essential calls blocked

Spend is tracked per request against a hard monthly ceiling, with atomic writes so the ledger survives a restart.

Fallback. In the ADK version I built on, the model wrapper called the provider directly and ignored the underlying library’s fallback configuration, so that setting did nothing. I wrapped the model layer with one that implements it.

  • A health tracker records rate-limited models and applies an escalating cooldown that grows with repeat offenses. Later calls skip a cooling-down model rather than hitting the same wall.
  • A time-to-first-token watchdog bounds only the first response of an attempt. A model that stalls without emitting trips it and the call moves to the next model. Because nothing was yielded, there is no duplicate output. Once a stream starts it runs unbounded, with a longer outer timeout as backstop.
  • A fallback model that cannot accept the tool definitions is skipped as a compatibility miss, not reported as a failure.
  • If the chain is exhausted, the layer returns a message stating that specialist is unavailable rather than crashing the run group.

Chains terminate on different models per role, so no two roles share a last resort. Any workload can be pinned to a model on the server as a final option.

A failure worth recording. Agents intermittently produced worse output, with more hedging and occasional refusals, and nothing in the error logs. The cause was the cost router: under budget pressure it substituted a cheaper model, which returned success and behaved differently. The fix was to surface the substitution. Every swap now appears on the result card and in tracing, so the first question on a behavioral regression is which model served the call.

See: examples/model_fallback.py for the fallback pattern, with the reasoning in the comments · examples/model-routing.example.yaml for budget structure.

4 · Operations and limits · deployment, and what this is not

This runs as versioned, monitored infrastructure with a gated deployment path.

  • Segmented. Docker services across four network tiers (public-facing, internal, outbound, isolated sandbox) plus purpose-built networks, so the blast radius of one service is bounded. Ingress is through a Cloudflare Tunnel; the origin is not directly exposed.
  • Sandboxed execution. Agent-run code executes in an isolated sandbox with an ephemeral workspace on its own network tier.
  • Gated deployment. A push triggers pull, rebuild, health check, and a build-provenance check that the running build matches what was deployed, so a deploy that reported success without swapping the image is caught. A drift job reconciles configuration.
  • Maintenance. A watchdog flags dependency and security updates. Low-risk ones merge through CI; the rest escalate.
  • Observability. Spend attributed per request and per model. Every call and every model swap traced.

Limits.

  • Single operator, by design. The reliability and privilege patterns are real mechanisms operating at personal scale. No claim is made about enterprise load, multi-tenancy, or an adversarial threat model.
  • One router in the path. Hosted models are reached through a single gateway, so a router outage is a shared dependency. Pinning to the local model mitigates it; it does not remove it.
  • The demo is not connected. Real interface, sample data, no link to the running system.
  • Semantic memory is a hosted service. The one cloud dependency in an otherwise local stack. Swappable, and not the system of record.
  • Retrieval tuning is ongoing. Hybrid retrieval covers more than keyword alone, but ranking is not a solved problem here.
  • Not a high-security design. Serious about data control, not a threat model against a determined adversary.

Rebuilding it. Point a coding agent at the architecture and rebuild the parts you want on what you already have. A working floor:

Item Cost
Coding assistant ~$20/mo
Small server ~$20/mo
Metered model calls, budget roster, personal load $10-40/mo

So roughly $50-80/mo, scaling up only where depth is wanted. My own build runs heavier because I develop it daily.

Artifacts.

  • examples/model-routing.example.yaml: the real config structure, with illustrative model IDs and figures.
  • examples/model_fallback.py: the resilient-call pattern, simplified.

sentences.zh: 从我的来源更新自身，整理噪音，并将数据维护在我的私有数据库中。

blocks.html_en: • Uses a multi-agent tree to route work to the model best suited for it.

sentences.en: Uses a multi-agent tree to route work to the model best suited for it.
sentences.zh: 使用多代理树将工作路由到最适合它的模型。

blocks.html_en: • Remembers my choices and preferences, and learns from past outcomes (applying lessons learned to new tasks or situations).

sentences.en: Remembers my choices and preferences, and learns from past outcomes (applying lessons learned to new tasks or situations).

sentences.en: What I stopped building

blocks.html_en: I learned quickly to prioritize durability, utility, and productivity over novelty. The system is not a product, and it is not a research project. It is a tool I use every day, and it has to work when I’m not there or don’t have the time to maintain it. I had originally built mobile and desktop clients to reach it, but they were more work than I could comfortably invest. I deleted them and now reach it from the tools (MCP, plugins, hooks) commonplace throughout AI development. It’s been important to futureproof the system, and the design is intentionally service-agnostic so it can flex to whatever is best at the time.

sentences.en: I learned quickly to prioritize durability, utility, and productivity over novelty.

sentences.en: The system is not a product, and it is not a research project.
sentences.zh: 该系统不是产品，也不是研究项目。

sentences.en: It is a tool I use every day, and it has to work when I’m not there or don’t have the time to maintain it.
sentences.zh: 它是我每天使用的工具，当我不在或没有时间维护它时它也必须工作。

sentences.en: I had originally built mobile and desktop clients to reach it, but they were more work than I could comfortably invest.
sentences.zh: 我最初构建了移动和桌面客户端来实现这一目标，但它们的工作量超出了我可以轻松投入的范围。

sentences.en: I deleted them and now reach it from the tools (MCP, plugins, hooks) commonplace throughout AI development.
sentences.zh: 我删除了它们，现在可以通过 AI 开发中常见的工具（MCP、插件、挂钩）来获取它。

sentences.en: It’s been important to futureproof the system, and the design is intentionally service-agnostic so it can flex to whatever is best at the time.
sentences.zh: 让系统面向未来非常重要，并且设计有意与服务无关，因此它可以灵活适应当时最好的情况。

sentences.en: How a request is handled

sentences.en: Eight agents do the work: one that reads the request and routes it, and seven specialists for research, code, analysis, review, and related work.

sentences.en: Each runs on a model chosen for that job, so a short lookup and a long analysis do not draw the same cost or wait on the same machinery.
sentences.zh: 每个都在为该作业选择的模型上运行，因此短查找和长分析不会产生相同的成本或在相同的机器上等待。

sentences.en: Answers carry their sources, so a claim can be traced, and the cost of the call, so spending stays visible as it happens rather than at the end of the month.

sentences.en: The parts that accumulate stay on my server.
sentences.zh: 累积的部分保留在我的服务器上。

sentences.en: The model is the one part I do not control, so it is treated as replaceable.

sentences.en: What is stored is exportable and deletable, and is not used for training.
sentences.zh: 存储的内容是可导出和删除的，并且不用于培训。

blocks.html_en: I hold what accumulates, I decide where requests go, and none of it becomes a vendor’s asset.

sentences.en: I hold what accumulates, I decide where requests go, and none of it becomes a vendor’s asset.

What I still pay for is the model, and one hosted memory service that stays swappable and is not the system of record.

sentences.en: Almost all of it is open source, assembled and run on my own server rather than rented as a service.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有内容都是开源的，在我自己的服务器上组装和运行，而不是作为服务租用。

sentences.en: Where an open-source equivalent did the job, I switched to it and kept the data.
sentences.zh: 当开源等效工具可以完成这项工作时，我转而使用它并保留数据。

sentences.en: What I still pay for is the model, and one hosted memory service that stays swappable and is not the system of record.
sentences.zh: 我仍然支付的是模型，以及一种保持可交换且不是记录系统的托管内存服务。

blocks.html_en: Building it

sentences.en: Building it
sentences.zh: 构建它

blocks.html_en: While computer science and software engineering have always been intriguing, I didn’t have any background developing code myself. The development of this system has been possible through working in partnership with the numerous tools and services currently available online. The architecture itself has all been created independently: which components exist, how they connect, what each runs on, how it behaves when a part fails, and what it is allowed to ‘spend’ (the budget for each module or platform). I built it AI-natively, specifying and reviewing while coding agents wrote most of the code.

sentences.en: While computer science and software engineering have always been intriguing, I didn’t have any background developing code myself.
sentences.zh: 虽然计算机科学和软件工程一直很有趣，但我自己没有任何开发代码的背景。

sentences.en: The development of this system has been possible through working in partnership with the numerous tools and services currently available online.
sentences.zh: 通过与当前在线可用的众多工具和服务合作，该系统的开发成为可能。

sentences.en: The architecture itself has all been created independently: which components exist, how they connect, what each runs on, how it behaves when a part fails, and what it is allowed to ‘spend’ (the budget for each module or platform).
sentences.zh: 架构本身都是独立创建的：存在哪些组件、它们如何连接、每个组件在什么上运行、当某个部件发生故障时它的行为方式以及允许“花费”的内容（每个模块或平台的预算）。

sentences.en: I built it AI-natively, specifying and reviewing while coding agents wrote most of the code.
sentences.zh: 我用人工智能原生构建了它，在编码代理编写大部分代码时进行指定和审查。

blocks.html_en: It has run since early 2026 and I use it daily. Most of what the technical sections describe came out of operating it rather than planning it. For example, the fallback layer exists because the framework’s own fallback setting turned out to do nothing. Another instance, the model label on every answer exists as a way to backtrace a behavioral regression to a model swap that was invisible in the logs. Most of the issues I hit in production were not bugs but design gaps, and it was only through operating the system that I discovered them.

sentences.en: It has run since early 2026 and I use it daily.
sentences.zh: 它自 2026 年初开始运行，我每天都使用它。

sentences.en: Most of what the technical sections describe came out of operating it rather than planning it.
sentences.zh: 技术部分描述的大部分内容来自于操作而不是规划。

sentences.en: For example, the fallback layer exists because the framework’s own fallback setting turned out to do nothing.
sentences.zh: 例如，后备层的存在是因为框架自己的后备设置没有执行任何操作。

sentences.en: Another instance, the model label on every answer exists as a way to backtrace a behavioral regression to a model swap that was invisible in the logs.
sentences.zh: 另一个例子，每个答案上的模型标签都是作为一种将行为回归回溯到日志中不可见的模型交换的方式而存在的。

sentences.en: Most of the issues I hit in production were not bugs but design gaps, and it was only through operating the system that I discovered them.
sentences.zh: 我在生产中遇到的大多数问题不是错误，而是设计缺陷，只有通过操作系统我才发现它们。

blocks.html_en: Because I built Pacific Slate while working and going to grad school, my free time (or lack thereof) shaped the design more than anything else. It had to be useful in the hours I wasn’t there: scheduled runs, low-risk dependencies and security updates that merge on their own, and failures that degrade to a working state rather than waiting for me.

sentences.en: Because I built Pacific Slate while working and going to grad school, my free time (or lack thereof) shaped the design more than anything else.
sentences.zh: 因为我在工作和读研究生时建造了 Pacific Slate，所以我的空闲时间（或缺乏空闲时间）比其他任何事情都更能影响设计。

sentences.en: It had to be useful in the hours I wasn’t there: scheduled runs, low-risk dependencies and security updates that merge on their own, and failures that degrade to a working state rather than waiting for me.
sentences.zh: 它必须在我不在的时候有用：预定的运行、低风险的依赖项和自行合并的安全更新，以及降级到工作状态而不是等待我的故障。

sentences.en: Technical detail
sentences.zh: 技术细节

blocks.html_en: Model names on this page and in the example config are illustrative; the design is model-agnostic and the roster rotates. Counts are current as of August 2026 and were checked against the running system.

sentences.en: Model names on this page and in the example config are illustrative; the design is model-agnostic and the roster rotates.
sentences.zh: 本页和示例配置中的型号名称仅供参考；该设计与模型无关，并且名册会轮换。

sentences.en: Counts are current as of August 2026 and were checked against the running system.
sentences.zh: 计数截至 2026 年 8 月，并根据运行系统进行了检查。

blocks.html_en: A designed multi-agent system, not a chat model with plugins.

sentences.en: A designed multi-agent system, not a chat model with plugins.
sentences.zh: 设计的多代理系统，而不是带有插件的聊天模型。

blocks.html_en: A multi-agent tree on Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK): one operator at the root plus seven specialists (coder, researcher, analyst, productivity, reviewer, evaluator, and a research sub-agent scoped to the coder).

sentences.en: A multi-agent tree on Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK): one operator at the root plus seven specialists (coder, researcher, analyst, productivity, reviewer, evaluator, and a research sub-agent scoped to the coder).
sentences.zh: Google 代理开发工具包 (ADK) 上的多代理树：根部有一名操作员，加上七名专家（编码员、研究员、分析师、生产力人员、审阅员、评估员和范围为编码员的研究子代理）。

blocks.html_en: • Cost and fit. Each role maps to the model best suited and priced for its work.

sentences.en: Cost and fit.
sentences.zh: 成本和适合度。

sentences.en: Each role maps to the model best suited and priced for its work.
sentences.zh: 每个角色都映射到最适合其工作且定价最合适的模型。

blocks.html_en: • Independent review. The evaluator runs on a different model family than the agents whose output it scores. Different weights are not guaranteed different biases, but it beats self-scoring. The reviewer is a separate instance kept off the write path by policy.

sentences.en: Independent review.
sentences.zh: 独立审查。

sentences.en: The evaluator runs on a different model family than the agents whose output it scores.
sentences.zh: 评估器运行在与对其输出进行评分的代理不同的模型系列上。

sentences.en: Different weights are not guaranteed different biases, but it beats self-scoring.
sentences.zh: 不同的权重不能保证不同的偏差，但它胜过自我评分。

sentences.en: The reviewer is a separate instance kept off the write path by policy.
sentences.zh: 审阅者是一个单独的实例，根据策略远离写入路径。

blocks.html_en: • Least privilege. Tools are scoped per role by explicit allow-list. The researcher cannot reach infrastructure. The reviewer is read-only by charter. The productivity agent’s credentials are isolated, so a failure there cannot take down the operator.

sentences.en: Least privilege.
sentences.zh: 最小特权。

sentences.en: Tools are scoped per role by explicit allow-list.
sentences.zh: 工具通过明确的允许列表按角色划分范围。

sentences.en: The researcher cannot reach infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 研究人员无法到达基础设施。

sentences.en: The reviewer is read-only by charter.
sentences.zh: 根据章程，审阅者是只读的。

sentences.en: The productivity agent’s credentials are isolated, so a failure there cannot take down the operator.
sentences.zh: 生产力代理的凭证是隔离的，因此那里的故障不会让操作员垮台。

blocks.html_en: • Containment. A rate-limit or crash stays inside one specialist.

sentences.en: Containment.
sentences.zh: 遏制。

sentences.en: A rate-limit or crash stays inside one specialist.
sentences.zh: 速率限制或崩溃由专家负责。

blocks.html_en: • ADK enforces a single-parent constraint on sub-agents, which is why the coder’s research arm is a separate instance from the standalone researcher despite sharing a model and tools.

sentences.en: ADK enforces a single-parent constraint on sub-agents, which is why the coder’s research arm is a separate instance from the standalone researcher despite sharing a model and tools.
sentences.zh: ADK 对子代理强制执行单父约束，这就是为什么编码器的研究部门是独立于独立研究人员的单独实例，尽管共享模型和工具。

blocks.html_en: • Specialists publish findings to a Redis event stream that peers read as ambient context. Longer asynchronous jobs hand off to a background orchestrator rather than occupying the synchronous path.

sentences.en: Specialists publish findings to a Redis event stream that peers read as ambient context.
sentences.zh: 专家将调查结果发布到 Redis 事件流，同行将其视为环境上下文。

sentences.en: Longer asynchronous jobs hand off to a background orchestrator rather than occupying the synchronous path.
sentences.zh: 较长的异步作业将移交给后台协调器，而不是占用同步路径。

sentences.en: Scheduled routines pull from many sources and score each candidate item for relevance, materiality, and novelty before it can enter a brief.

blocks.html_en: • Algorithm first. Default data access and classification to something deterministic: regex, an index, SQL, set membership. Use a model only for the irreducible part. The complexity scorer, the tool search, and the memory relevance pass are all applications of this.

sentences.en: Algorithm first.
sentences.zh: 先说算法。

sentences.en: Default data access and classification to something deterministic: regex, an index, SQL, set membership.
sentences.zh: 默认数据访问和分类是确定性的：正则表达式、索引、SQL、集合成员资格。

sentences.en: Use a model only for the irreducible part.
sentences.zh: 仅对不可约部分使用模型。

sentences.en: The complexity scorer, the tool search, and the memory relevance pass are all applications of this.
sentences.zh: 复杂性评分器、工具搜索和内存相关性传递都是这一点的应用。

blocks.html_en: • Make failure visible, then cheap. Each reliability fix pairs a guardrail with a trace, so the same class of problem cannot recur unseen.

sentences.en: Make failure visible, then cheap.

sentences.en: Each reliability fix pairs a guardrail with a trace, so the same class of problem cannot recur unseen.
sentences.zh: 每个可靠性修复都会将护栏与跟踪配对，因此同一类问题不会在看不见的情况下再次出现。

blocks.html_en: • Resilience over peak capability. Where the two conflict, uptime wins.

Because nothing was yielded, there is no duplicate output. Once a stream starts it runs unbounded, with a longer outer timeout as backstop.

sentences.en: A time-to-first-token watchdog bounds only the first response of an attempt.
sentences.zh: 首次令牌时间看门狗仅限制尝试的第一次响应。

sentences.en: A model that stalls without emitting trips it and the call moves to the next model.
sentences.zh: 停止运行但未发出信号的模型会触发该模型，并且调用会移至下一个模型。

blocks.html_en: A failure worth recording. Agents intermittently produced worse output, with more hedging and occasional refusals, and nothing in the error logs. The cause was the cost router: under budget pressure it substituted a cheaper model, which returned success and behaved differently. The fix was to surface the substitution. Every swap now appears on the result card and in tracing, so the first question on a behavioral regression is which model served the call.

sentences.en: A failure worth recording.

sentences.en: Agents intermittently produced worse output, with more hedging and occasional refusals, and nothing in the error logs.

sentences.en: The cause was the cost router: under budget pressure it substituted a cheaper model, which returned success and behaved differently.
sentences.zh: 原因在于成本路由器：在预算压力下，它取代了更便宜的型号，该型号返回了成功，但表现不同。

sentences.en: The fix was to surface the substitution.
sentences.zh: 解决办法是让替代品浮出水面。

sentences.en: Every swap now appears on the result card and in tracing, so the first question on a behavioral regression is which model served the call.
sentences.zh: 现在，每次交换都会出现在结果卡和跟踪中，因此行为回归的第一个问题是哪个模型服务于调用。

content_html_zh:
当时我正在攻读 MBA 的第一年，一边尝试管理大量信息，一边申请实习并与我的妻子和两个孩子保持联系，我不断向我那周使用的人工智能程序重新解释我的整个情况。 我想要一个能够自我更新、过滤废液并保留数据的系统。

我建立这个网站是为了向任何想要做类似事情的人分享结构。 这并不是要购买的服务或产品，而是您可以将其交给自己的法学硕士并用作指南。

它在租用的服务器上运行，这是一台托管服务并保存我关心的文件的加密备份的专用机器。 我设计了它，选择了零件，并每天运行它（技术细节在底部的折叠部分）。

它的作用

  • 从我的来源更新自身，整理噪音，并将数据维护在我的私有数据库中。
  • 使用多代理树将工作路由到最适合它的模型。
  • 记住我的选择和偏好，并从过去的结果中学习（将学到的经验教训应用于新的任务或情况）。
  • 引用来源并维护其所做一切的日志，从而实现可追溯性和问责制。
  • 检查源文档而不是相信它所记住的内容。
  • 集成到我已经使用的工具和服务中，因此它可以适应我的工作流程，而不是强迫我改变它。

我停止建造的东西

我很快就学会了优先考虑耐用性、实用性和生产力，而不是新颖性。 该系统不是产品，也不是研究项目。 它是我每天使用的工具，当我不在或没有时间维护它时它也必须工作。 我最初构建了移动和桌面客户端来实现这一目标，但它们的工作量超出了我可以轻松投入的范围。 我删除了它们，现在可以通过 AI 开发中常见的工具（MCP、插件、挂钩）来获取它。 让系统面向未来非常重要，并且设计有意与服务无关，因此它可以灵活适应当时最好的情况。

如何处理请求

八名代理负责这项工作：一名负责读取请求并路由请求，七名专家负责研究、编码、分析、审查和相关工作。 每个都在为该作业选择的模型上运行，因此短查找和长分析不会产生相同的成本或在相同的机器上等待。

答案带有其来源，因此可以追踪索赔，以及通话费用，因此支出在发生时而不是在月底时保持可见。

界面

来自公共演示的工作区。 答案以可以移动的卡片形式出现，而不是以一条长线的形式出现，每张卡片上都标有所使用的模型、成本和所用的时间。

演示：pacslate.com/demo。 样本数据的真实接口。

  • 帆布。 输入提示或观看它运行。 打开
  • 监视器。 仪表板。 地震数据和头条新闻是实时的，在浏览器中获取；市场、飞机和任何个人的东西都被标记为样本数据。 打开

什么是我的，什么是租的

累积的部分保留在我的服务器上。 模型是租的。

该模型是我无法控制的一部分，因此它被视为可替换的。 更换更好的产品是一种配置更改。

存储的内容是可导出和删除的，并且不用于培训。 发出的请求仅限于零数据保留端点，在配置为不对其进行训练或发布的提供商处（帐户设置，2026 年 8 月）。 如果服务器不应该离开任何内容，则可以将工作指向在其上运行的模型。

我持有积累的东西，我决定请求的去向，而这些都不会成为供应商的资产。

开源以及我付出的代价

几乎所有内容都是开源的，在我自己的服务器上组装和运行，而不是作为服务租用。 当开源等效工具可以完成这项工作时，我转而使用它并保留数据。 我仍然支付的是模型，以及一种保持可交换且不是记录系统的托管内存服务。

构建它

虽然计算机科学和软件工程一直很有趣，但我自己没有任何开发代码的背景。 通过与当前在线可用的众多工具和服务合作，该系统的开发成为可能。 架构本身都是独立创建的：存在哪些组件、它们如何连接、每个组件在什么上运行、当某个部件发生故障时它的行为方式以及允许“花费”的内容（每个模块或平台的预算）。 我用人工智能原生构建了它，在编码代理编写大部分代码时进行指定和审查。

它自 2026 年初开始运行，我每天都使用它。 技术部分描述的大部分内容来自于操作而不是规划。 例如，后备层的存在是因为框架自己的后备设置没有执行任何操作。 另一个例子，每个答案上的模型标签都是作为一种将行为回归回溯到日志中不可见的模型交换的方式而存在的。 我在生产中遇到的大多数问题不是错误，而是设计缺陷，只有通过操作系统我才发现它们。

因为我在工作和读研究生时建造了 Pacific Slate，所以我的空闲时间（或缺乏空闲时间）比其他任何事情都更能影响设计。 它必须在我不在的时候有用：预定的运行、低风险的依赖项和自行合并的安全更新，以及降级到工作状态而不是等待我的故障。

技术细节

本页和示例配置中的型号名称仅供参考；该设计与模型无关，并且名册会轮换。 计数截至 2026 年 8 月，并根据运行系统进行了检查。

1 · Agents and memory · the design, not the assembly

设计的多代理系统，而不是带有插件的聊天模型。

Google 代理开发工具包 (ADK) 上的多代理树：根部有一名操作员，加上七名专家（编码员、研究员、分析师、生产力人员、审阅员、评估员和范围为编码员的研究子代理）。

  • 成本和适合度。 每个角色都映射到最适合其工作且定价最合适的模型。
  • 独立审查。 评估器运行在与对其输出进行评分的代理不同的模型系列上。 不同的权重不能保证不同的偏差，但它胜过自我评分。 审阅者是一个单独的实例，根据策略远离写入路径。
  • 最小特权。 工具通过明确的允许列表按角色划分范围。 研究人员无法到达基础设施。 根据章程，审阅者是只读的。 生产力代理的凭证是隔离的，因此那里的故障不会让操作员垮台。
  • 遏制。 速率限制或崩溃由专家负责。
  • ADK 对子代理强制执行单父约束，这就是为什么编码器的研究部门是独立于独立研究人员的单独实例，尽管共享模型和工具。
  • 专家将调查结果发布到 Redis 事件流，同行将其视为环境上下文。 较长的异步作业将移交给后台协调器，而不是占用同步路径。

模型独立性。 底层以两种方式公开：MCP 网关（通过模型上下文协议的工具和内存，可由任何支持 MCP 的客户端安装）和 OpenAI 兼容端点。 当模型移动时，内存、数据、工具、路由和验证不会移动。

两条规则支配着这一切。 确定性相关性传递决定在任何模型运行之前加载什么，无需模型调用。 召回的内存被视为线索而不是事实：如果内存显示供应商在 7 月更新，代理会提取源文档并据此采取行动。

积极主动的工作。 预定的例程会从许多来源中提取信息，并对每个候选项目的相关性、实质性和新颖性进行评分，然后才能进入摘要。 丢弃的项目会被记录下来，而不是默默地丢弃，因此可以审核过滤器。 整合阶段会在存储任何内容之前进行重复数据删除和标准化，并在传入过程中筛选凭据和个人数据。

经营原则。

  • 先说算法。 默认数据访问和分类是确定性的：正则表达式、索引、SQL、集合成员资格。 仅对不可约部分使用模型。 复杂性评分器、工具搜索和内存相关性传递都是这一点的应用。
  • 让失败变得可见，这样成本就低了。 每个可靠性修复都会将护栏与跟踪配对，因此同一类问题不会在看不见的情况下再次出现。
  • 超过峰值能力的弹性。 当两者发生冲突时，正常运行时间胜出。
  • 成本作为设计约束。 真正的上限迫使人们对模型、上下文大小以及何时使用模型做出诚实的选择。

2 · Integration · models, tools, data, and interface as one system

模型提供者、工具、数据、内存和前端被集成到一个可通过标准接口访问的环境中。

请求路径：

  1. 画布是一个 Next.js 单页应用程序，打开流连接并发布提示。 流式处理在服务器发送的事件上使用 AG-UI 协议，因此令牌、工具调用和模型解析事件会到达一个流。
  2. 后端是一个 Starlette 服务，公开画布的 AG-UI 端点和其他客户端的 OpenAI 兼容端点。
  3. 操作员对请求进行分类，然后在线回答或交给专家。
  4. 专家通过 MCP 加载上下文并调用工具。
  5. 弹性模型层解析该调用的模型，应用成本感知降级和运行状况感知回退（第 3 节），流式传输完成情况并计量成本。
  6. 答案会以一张标有型号和成本的卡片的形式返回。 持久的事实被写入记忆。

结果是两个速度层：单个模型调用中的内联答案，以及专家在其自己的工具循环中工作的委托运行。

3 · Reliability and cost · the part that took the most iteration

它保持运转，保持在预算范围内，并检查自己的产出，并且每个机制都是可观察的。

截至 2026 年 8 月的 90 天跟踪：13,053 次运行、26,515 次模型调用、9 个模型提供流量。 模型调用的中位数在 3.1 秒内完成；第 90 个百分位数是 14 秒。

成本控制，在通话前应用。 确定性评分器根据字数、关键字类别、代码标记、角色权重和对话深度对复杂性进行 1 到 5 的评分，不涉及任何模型。 该分数和当前预算状态选择等级：

使用的每月预算 行为
Under 80% 其指定模型上的每个角色
80 to 95% 琐碎的任务被降级
95 to 100% 除必要的高复杂性工作外的所有工作均被降级
At 100% 阻止非必要呼叫

根据严格的每月上限跟踪每个请求的支出，并使用原子写入，以便分类帐在重新启动后仍然存在。

倒退。 在我构建的 ADK 版本中，模型包装器直接调用提供程序并忽略底层库的后备配置，因此该设置什么也不做。 我用实现它的层包装了模型层。

  • 健康跟踪器记录速率受限的模型，并应用随着重复攻击而不断增加的冷却时间。 后来的调用会跳过冷却模型，而不是撞到同一堵墙。
  • 首次令牌时间看门狗仅限制尝试的第一次响应。 停止运行但未发出信号的模型会触发该模型，并且调用会移至下一个模型。 因为没有产生任何结果，所以没有重复的输出。 一旦流启动，它就会无限运行，并以较长的外部超时作为后备。
  • 无法接受工具定义的后备模型将作为兼容性缺失而被跳过，而不是报告为失败。
  • 如果链耗尽，该层会返回一条消息，指出专家不可用，而不是使运行组崩溃。

每个角色的链终止于不同的模型，因此没有两个角色共享最后的手段。 作为最终选择，任何工作负载都可以固定到服务器上的模型。

一次值得记录的失败。 代理间歇性地产生更差的输出，有更多的对冲和偶尔的拒绝，并且错误日志中没有任何内容。 原因在于成本路由器：在预算压力下，它取代了更便宜的型号，该型号返回了成功，但表现不同。 解决办法是让替代品浮出水面。 现在，每次交换都会出现在结果卡和跟踪中，因此行为回归的第一个问题是哪个模型服务于调用。

请参阅：examples/model_fallback.py 了解后备模式，并在注释中推理 · Examples/model-routing.example.yaml 了解预算结构。

4 · Operations and limits · deployment, and what this is not

它作为版本控制、受监控的基础设施运行，具有门控部署路径。

  • 分段。 Docker 服务跨越四个网络层（面向公众、内部、出站、隔离沙箱）以及专用网络，因此一项服务的传播半径是有限的。 入口是通过 Cloudflare 隧道；起源并没有直接暴露。
  • 沙盒执行。 代理运行的代码在隔离的沙箱中执行，并在其自己的网络层上有一个临时工作区。
  • 门控部署。 推送会触发拉取、重建、运行状况检查以及构建来源检查，以确保正在运行的构建与部署的内容相匹配，因此可以捕获在未交换映像的情况下报告成功的部署。 漂移作业协调配置。
  • 维护。 看门狗标记依赖性和安全更新。 低风险的通过CI合并；其余的则升级。
  • 可观察性。 每个请求和每个模型的支出。 每次调用和每次模型交换都会被追踪。

限制。

  • 单一操作员，按设计。 可靠性和特权模式是在个人规模上运行的真实机制。 没有对企业负载、多租户或对抗性威胁模型做出任何声明。
  • 路径中有一台路由器。 托管模型是通过单个网关访问的，因此路由器中断是一种共享依赖关系。 固定到本地模型可以缓解这种情况；它不会删除它。
  • 演示未连接。 真实界面，样本数据，与运行系统没有链接。
  • 语义记忆是一项托管服务。 本地堆栈中的一个云依赖项。 可交换，而不是记录系统。
  • 检索调整正在进行中。 混合检索不仅仅涵盖关键字，但排名并不是这里解决的问题。
  • 不是高安全性设计。 认真对待数据控制，而不是针对坚定对手的威胁模型。
